definitions.gloss: same year, same class, same cohort
definitions.explanation: People who entered a company, school, or organization in the same year. An important concept in Japanese workplace culture, where cohort bonds are strong.
Aligning the timing or data of two or more systems. Used in computing, engineering, and telecommunications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同期|どうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is the most talented among those who joined the same year.
I went drinking with colleagues from the same cohort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{同期|どうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三十|さんじゅう}{人|にん}→三十人：30473_sanjuunin⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。
examples.english: There were thirty people in my cohort when we joined the company, but only half remain now.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同期|どうき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同期|どうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかない。
examples.english: The synchronization between my smartphone and computer isn't working well.

examples.english: It's set to automatically sync with the cloud.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is central to Japanese workplace culture. {同期|どうき} bonds are often lifelong, and colleagues from the same hiring year form a natural support network. Can be used as a noun modifier: {同期|どうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (lit. "cherry blossoms of the same year" — comrades who share the same fate).

Sense 2 is the technical meaning used in IT and engineering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同期|どうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧: cohort members, colleagues from the same year
- ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{同期|どうき}: same-year company entrants
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同期|どうき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sync data
- ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧{同期|どうき}: automatic synchronization
